verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de offers event webhooks: you register a URL in the dashboard, receive real-time notifications for events such as `appointment.completed`, and verify them with HMAC-SHA256 signatures. Customers can therefore wire their own automated reactions, but the product itself has no evidenced in-product rule engine for defining triggers and actions. Missing for 10: native rule or trigger-action configuration, documented event catalogue and filtering, conditional logic, independent corroboration.
